description: Per-image CLIP predictions on Stanford40 (ViT-L-14 laion2b_s32b_b82k, FP16, 3-template averaged), same protocol as anchor_stanford40.py. Run on V100 (broadsense@192.168.20.35), conda env dl_env_310 (open-clip-torch 2.24.0), cached weights ~/.cache/clip/ViT-L-14.pt, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, STANFORD40_DIR=/home/broadsense/works/lizhuo/data. Known discrepancy vs canonical anchor_scores.json: one 'playing guitar' image differs (canonical 99.65% vs this run 100.00%, i.e., exactly one image among 289), attributable to a replaced image file in the server copy; impact on any downstream aggregate is at most 1/9532 = 0.0105pp.
